title: 第9章 竞价第10章 透视第11章 买房
content_zh:
“接下来第二件拍品是一副画！众所周知，清代扬州八怪之一的郑板桥画的竹十分传神。”
“有人说其‘神似坡公，多不乱，少不疏，脱尽时习，秀劲绝伦’。而我们的第二件拍品则是郑板桥的《墨竹图》！此件拍品底价八百万，每次加价不低于十万，现在开始竞拍！”
一听到时郑板桥画作，许多酷爱收藏字画的收藏家都心动了。
一时间纷纷竞价，最后这《墨竹图》以一千四百万的价格被一位私人博物馆馆长收入囊中。
后面的藏品大多是字画，白月对这些实在是提不起兴趣，听得都快打瞌睡了。
不过却还是被瑞云拍卖行这大手笔的规格给镇住了！要知道，现在拍卖的拍品可都是一千万左右拍出的！
直到中途休息时主持人说接下来会有追加的神秘拍品出现，让大家不要错过，白月才湛湛打起了精神。
“下面我们来拍卖追加的拍品，第一件是明永乐的青花花卉纹八方烛台，明代盛行八方烛台！”
“此八角烛台仿自阿拉伯铜器，结构复杂，装饰华美，为明代宫廷的御用瓷器，具有很高的艺术观赏价值，喜爱艺术的收藏家们可千万不要错过了！”
“此件拍品底价五百万，每次加价不低于十万，现在可以出价了！”
台上主持人兴致勃勃的说着，底下也有条不紊的竞拍着。
最终这八方烛台以一千万的价格被拍走。
之后的竞价也是大同小异，明成化的秋葵纹碗拍出了三千万的价格；青花釉里红鱼纹盘却只拍出了五百万的价格。
那清乾隆的粉彩百鹿尊竟被拍出了三千万！据说是一个败家子为了讨好家中长辈所拍，真是令人大跌眼镜。
白月心中估摸着赚到的钱。
去除交给拍卖行佣金——那从拍品里成交价分出的百分之十，白月一下子就多了六千七百五十万！
数得白月那双眼蹭蹭的发亮，仿佛这几千万大元已经摆在了她眼前，正闪闪发光引诱着她一般！
“下面这一件拍品是我们老板无意中在矿堆发现的，似是春秋战国时期的匕首。“
“这把匕首长六寸，外形小巧精致，它的材质至今还不详，据说是天外陨石所造，用科学仪器测试也测不出其内部未知的金属是什么物质，是一把来历神秘的匕首。“
“如果有喜爱收藏冷兵器的藏家可就不容错过了！这件拍品的底价为两百万，每次加价不低于十万！”

主持人在台上滔滔不绝，而台下却没有丝毫回应。
看着台下这冷冷清清的场面，主持人也是尴尬，直怀疑这一件老板兴致起来拍卖的一件藏品不会就此这么流拍了吧？
也的确，收藏冷兵器的藏家的确少之又少，一般的大热古玩都是诸如瓷器字画还有青铜器一流，鲜少有人会花大价钱去买这种偏门的古玩。
不过，还是有人会卖面子给傅老板的。
场中顿时响起了稀稀落落的竞价声，但是提价都是十万十万的慢慢往上提，让一旁无意竞拍的人丝毫提不起精神来。
“五百万！”
随着一处包厢内的突然竞价，人群纷纷看向了A字包厢的位置，探究其中的到底是哪位大人物。
要知道，坐在大堂最次的都已经是身家百万的成功人士，而能坐得起在那包厢之中的，必定是某个有头有脸的大人物！
想到这，原本竞拍的人都松了一口气，放弃了竞价，就当是卖个面子给包厢中的大人物了。
“月儿，你真看上那件匕首了？”
云风好奇的问一旁一直默不作声的白月。
“我觉得那件匕首，对我很有吸引力，而且多一把匕首防身，也没有什么坏处嘛！”
白月笑嘻嘻的回答，一面志在必得的看着台上的匕首。
她的直觉告诉她，这把匕首对她会有大用处。
“五百万第一次！”
“五百万第二次！”
content_en:
"The next lot is a painting! As we all know, the bamboo paintings painted by Zheng Banqiao, one of the Eight Eccentrics of Yangzhou in the Qing Dynasty, are very realistic."
"Some people say that he is 'like Po Gong in spirit, with more and less chaos, less and less, free from the customs of the times, and extremely beautiful.' And our second auction is Zheng Banqiao's "Ink Bamboo Painting"! The base price of this auction is 8 million, and each increase will not be less than 100,000. Bidding starts now!"
Upon hearing about Zheng Banqiao's paintings, many collectors who love collecting calligraphy and paintings became excited.
There was a lot of bidding for a while, and finally the "Ink Bamboo Picture" was acquired by a private museum director for 14 million.
Most of the collections at the back were calligraphy and paintings. Bai Yue was really not interested in these and almost dozed off while listening to them.
However, I was still stunned by the generous specifications of Ruiyun Auction House! You know, the auction items now all cost around 10 million!
It wasn't until the host said during the break that there would be additional mysterious auctions and asked everyone not to miss them, that Bai Yue Zhanzhan cheered up.
"Now let's auction additional items. The first item is the blue and white flower pattern eight-way candlestick from Ming Dynasty. Eight-way candlesticks were popular in the Ming Dynasty!"
"This octagonal candlestick is imitated from Arabic bronze. It has a complex structure and gorgeous decoration. It was the royal porcelain of the Ming Dynasty court. It has high artistic value. Collectors who love art must not miss it!"
"The base price of this lot is five million, and each increase will not be less than one hundred thousand. You can bid now!"
The host on the stage was talking enthusiastically, and the bidding was going on in an orderly manner below.
In the end, the Bafang Candlestick was auctioned off for 10 million.
The subsequent bidding was similar. An okra-patterned bowl from Chenghua in the Ming Dynasty was auctioned for 30 million, while a red fish-patterned plate with blue and white glaze was auctioned for only 5 million.
The pastel hundred deer statue from the Qianlong Emperor of the Qing Dynasty was sold for RMB 30 million! It is said that it was taken by a prodigal son in order to please the elders in his family. It is really shocking.
Bai Yue estimated the money in her mind.
Excluding the commission paid to the auction house - the 10% taken from the auction price, Bai Yue suddenly gained 67.5 million!
Bai Yue's eyes were shining brightly as she counted, as if these tens of millions of dollars had been placed in front of her eyes, glittering and tempting her!
"The following item was accidentally discovered by our boss in a mine. It seems to be a dagger from the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period."
"This dagger is six inches long and has a small and exquisite appearance. Its material is still unknown. It is said to be made of meteorites from outer space. Testing with scientific instruments has not been able to detect the unknown metal inside it. It is a dagger with a mysterious origin."
"If there are collectors who like to collect cold weapons, you shouldn't miss it! The base price of this auction is two million, and each increase in price will not be less than one hundred thousand!"
The host talked endlessly on the stage, but there was no response from the audience.
Seeing the deserted scene in the audience, the host was also embarrassed. He suspected that this collection that the boss was interested in auctioning would not be sold like this, right?
It is true that there are very few collectors of cold weapons. Generally popular antiques are such as porcelain, calligraphy, paintings and first-class bronzes. Very few people will spend a lot of money to buy such unconventional antiques.
However, there are still people who will sell face to Boss Fu.
Scattered bidding sounds suddenly sounded in the field, but the price increases were slowly raised by hundreds of thousands, which made the people on the side who had no intention of bidding lose their spirits at all.
"Five million!"
With the sudden bidding in a box, the crowd looked towards the A-shaped box to find out which big shot was in it.
You know, most of the people sitting in the lobby are already successful people with a net worth of millions, and the one who can afford to sit in that box must be a big shot with dignity!
Thinking of this, the people who originally bid for the auction breathed a sigh of relief and gave up bidding, thinking it was just to save face.It's for the big shot in the box.
"Yue'er, are you really interested in that dagger?"
Yunfeng curiously asked Bai Yue, who was silent all the time.
"I think that dagger is very attractive to me, and there's no harm in having an extra dagger for self-defense!"
Bai Yue answered with a smile, looking at the dagger on the stage with determination.
Her instinct told her that this dagger would be of great use to her.
"First time in five million!"
"Five million for the second time!"
